Right half: three stacked black lines, top to bottom — '>0 ⇒ Class I', '<0 ⇒ Class II', '=0 ⇒ Undefined Class' — grouped by a tall right curly brace '}' placed immediately to their right, cupping the three lines (see validation on brace orientation). 7. BOTTOM-RIGHT CAPTION: Draw a beige #e8e0c8 rectangle at approx. x=66%-85%, y=74%-82% (outside and to the right of the diagram box) containing the black text 'Binary Classification (2 Classes)', centered. 9.
